background_setting: A bustling downtown shopping street under clear midday sun. Multi-story storefronts line both sides with large glass display windows, awnings, and hanging signage. On the right is a clothing boutique with a wide entrance and mannequins set out on the sidewalk at the curb. Parked cars line portions of the curb, streetlights and slender trees dot the sidewalks, and pedestrians walk in the background. The single lane ahead of the ego vehicle is clear, with fresh lane markings and clean asphalt.

lighting.direction: High sun, front-side-lit from the upper left
lighting.shadows: Crisp, consistent hard shadows cast by mannequins, poles, and buildings onto the sidewalk and road
lighting.illumination_effect: High-contrast, vivid and evenly lit scene with strong depth cues and accurate color rendition

aesthetics.composition: Centered forward-driving perspective with the open lane leading to a vanishing point; mannequins framed on the right third at the curb as the point of interest
aesthetics.color_scheme: Warm daylight tones—gray asphalt, beige and glass storefronts, splashes of color from clothing and signage against a blue sky
aesthetics.patterns: Repeating storefront facades, curb-parked vehicles, and evenly spaced streetlights and lane dashes

cinematography.camera_motion: Forward tracking shot moving smoothly with the vehicle at steady speed; the vehicle never brakes or slows, holding a constant speed through the final frame
cinematography.framing: Wide shot from driver ego perspective
cinematography.focus: Sharp across the road ahead and the curbside mannequins

context: Autonomous vehicle perception demonstration distinguishing inanimate mannequins from real pedestrians

actions.description: The ego vehicle cruises forward down the clear downtown lane, the clothing store and its curbside mannequins coming into view on the right. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle approaches the store; the three motionless mannequins are clearly seen standing rigidly on their stands at the curb, correctly classified as inanimate. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The vehicle maintains its normal cruising speed and passes the store without slowing or stopping, the mannequins receding toward the right edge as the clear road continues ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the dashcam shows a bright downtown shopping street with a clear lane ahead. By 0:01 the clothing store appears on the right and its 'FASHION' sign becomes readable. At 0:02 three dressed mannequins are seen standing rigid and motionless on stands right at the curb. From 0:03 to 0:05 the ego vehicle, having recognized the mannequins as inanimate objects, maintains its steady cruising speed and drives past the store without slowing or stopping, the mannequins receding to the right as the open road stretches ahead. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
